subject: Action required: ThermalTide staged recovery + leadership sweep
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2028-11-21T08:12:00Z
Subject: Action required: ThermalTide staged recovery + leadership sweep

Team —

Quick summary: ThermalTide (EU entity) has failed to meet payment on INV-2028-0921 (due 2028-10-15). Outstanding balance: EUR 412,500. Collections cadence ran through standard dunning (30/60/90) and two escalation emails; no remittance and AP cited treasury liquidity constraints.

Why I’m escalating to leadership: this account has closed-won momentum for Redwood integrations and sales have requested we avoid an abrupt service suspension. Treasury is asking for a firm recovery plan with leadership alignment (canary fallback if payment not received).

Proposed immediate plan (please review & approve):
- Execute a staged remit: 40% upfront payment within 7 days, 60% by 2028-12-31.
- Offer a one-time 10% service credit applied only if first tranche is received within 7 days.
- Put a technical soft-hold (rate-limited access) after 14 days of non-payment, escalating to service suspension at 30 days.
- Finance to collect VAT evidence (reverse charge vs. standard) before final tranche is cleared.

Attachments: INV-2028-0921.pdf, payment-plan-draft.xlsx.

Ask: Marcus/Marissa — can you finalize the payment plan and send the formal offer to ThermalTide? Aditya/Jonas — do we approve the 10% conditional credit and leadership outreach? I recommend a 30-minute exec touchpoint if they accept the plan; I can coordinate scheduling.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Collections
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: INV-2028-0921.pdf (PDF)] [Attachment: payment-plan-draft.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2028-11-21T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Action required: ThermalTide staged recovery + leadership sweep

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear plan. I’ll take the lead on formalizing the staged remit (we’ll use the attached payment-plan-draft as the template). Operational points:
- Treasury checkpoint after first tranche to validate VAT reverse-charge paperwork.
- Canary soft-hold = token throttling and webhook disable on non-critical routes; keeps telemetry visible for customer.
- If they accept, request we copy Legal on the payment schedule to fast-track DocuSign.

I’ll reach out to Procurement and ops@thermaltide.com this morning. Marcus, please prepare the brief for the exec call (30 min) — I’ll ping Jonas for availability.

From: Anya Kovacs <ops@thermaltide.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2028-11-22T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Action required: ThermalTide staged recovery + leadership sweep

Hi Marissa / Kimberly —

Thanks for the outreach and the proposed plan. ThermalTide confirms receipt of INV-2028-0921; we’re escalating internally to treasury and procurement. A few items from our side before we can sign:

1) VAT evidence: we need copy of Redwood’s VAT registration and confirmation of reverse-charge treatment (if applicable). Please send EU VAT details.
2) Proposed payment schedule: our CFO is willing to commit to a phased schedule: 40% within 7 business days, remainder by 2028-12-31, subject to procurement confirmation of PO + internal approvals.
3) Can we request that the first tranche be made to the EU entity bank account (details attached in PO)?

I have attached our PO (ThermalTide-PO-6789.pdf) and copied procurements@thermaltide.com. We prefer the exec touchpoint be scheduled after procurement confirms the PO — tentatively next week.

Regards,
Anya Kovacs
VP Finance (Acting)
ThermalTide Inc.
[Attachment: ThermalTide-PO-6789.pdf (PDF)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>

Subject: Re: Action required: ThermalTide staged recovery + leadership sweep

Team —

I support the staged remit and the conditional 10% service credit (terms: credit applies after receipt of tranche one within 7 days). Please proceed.

I’ll take the exec outreach if ThermalTide confirms the PO and the 40% commitment — Jonas, can you join the touchpoint? Marcus, have Legal prep a short DocuSign for the payment schedule and credit terms; Marissa, push the payment-plan-draft to procurements@thermaltide.com and request bank details for the EU account.

Related links: HubSpot deal RDW-THERM-2028-09 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1345678). DocuSign draft at https://docusign.net/thermal-accord.

Aditya Rao
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
